name: gradebook-reporting
description: Recompute Google Classroom overall grades from exported scores, categories, weights and excused states, with a discrepancy ledger. Use pasted text or exports to trace scores, excused work, category contributions and reported differences.

interface.shortDescription: Recompute Google Classroom grades with a discrepancy ledger.
interface.longDescription: Recompute Google Classroom overall grades from exported scores, categories, weights and excused states, with a discrepancy ledger. Calculate totals or reconcile reported differences using supplied rows and grading settings.
defaultPrompt: Recompute these Google Classroom overall grades from my exported rows and settings.
Explain the differences between these Classroom and spreadsheet totals.
